body:
Adds `fetch_ezproxy.py` — the scriptable equivalent of clicking a **Click & Read / BibCNRS** button, to fetch paywalled articles the institution subscribes to without a shadow library.

## How it works
1. Resolve the DOI to the publisher URL (`doi.org` redirect).
2. Rewrite the host into EZproxy host-based form (`www.nature.com` → `www-nature-com.<EZPROXY_BASE>`) — same transform as the Zotero connector's `proxy.js`.
3. Download with your authenticated proxy **session cookies**; scrape `citation_pdf_url` / a `.pdf` link from a landing page if needed. Validate it's a real PDF.

## Config (env)
`EZPROXY_BASE` (institution host suffix), `EZPROXY_COOKIES` (cookies.txt exported after browser login), `EZPROXY_HYPHENS` (`reversible` default / `simple`). Fails fast + skipped by `--source all` when unset. Ordered after `istex`, before `scihub`.

## Why cookies not credentials
CNRS/BibCNRS uses federated SSO (Janus/RENATER) — can't be scripted blind. A live session (exported cookies) is supplied instead of a stored password.

## Tests
`tests/test_fetch_ezproxy.py` — rewrite (both schemes), config guards, mocked download. Ruff clean, 6 passed.

Ticket: none
